name: Observer Lite Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted uptime monitoring with HTTP, ICMP, SSL and heartbeat checks, email/Telegram alerts and dashboard; no vendor-enforced software usage quota or expiry documented.
watch_out: Self-hosted software only: provide Docker host, persistent SQLite storage, HTTPS, backups and SMTP/Telegram services. Upstream advertises monitoring 500+ endpoints but this is not a guaranteed free hosting quota. Change default admin/admin credentials on first login and set a strong SECRET_KEY before exposing the service.
